datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.numberofcredit,b.name from cm_active_credits p,CM_BOOROWERINFO b
where p.id=b.creditid

datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.* from cm_interests  a
where 
creditid=:creditid
order by hdate

datasets.name: CorrectData
datasets.sql:
/* Formatted on 2007/03/27 15:25 (Formatter Plus v4.7.0) */
SELECT s.ROWID, cm_correct.crdnumber_get (creditid) AS num,
       cm_correct.crdborrname_get (creditid) AS NAME, rest, interestrest,
       duerest, dueinterestrest, givenamount, obligation, penaltyrest
  FROM cm_curr_state s
order by  :orderfield
